title: Three guests, a payment link each

turns.guest: Three of us, mixed dorms, 10 to 14 July 2027. Quote please.
must: ask whether they pay together or separately

turns.guest: Our names are Nuria, Hugo and Alba.
Separately please. A link for each person.
must: three payment links, not one shared total invented by Luna

turns.guest: Yes, send a link each and book it.

pass.summary: Group of 3 chooses separate pay; a Staff-priced link each; booking saved.
